why: The features still behind Preferences > Experimental, by their row's id there, each with the commit scopes that are only about it. The notes leave out a commit in one of those scopes, or whose pull request says `Experimental: <id>` on a line of its own, while its feature is listed here at the release's tag. The pull request that takes a feature out of Experimental is a feat and removes its entry, so the next notes tell the feature as new, with every change to it since the last stable release.
